title: Uniform

scenes.continuity: Continuous night scene under the one tungsten bulb. Desk and blank board behind Nandini. No handcuffs, uniform state, pocket contents, eyeline or framing copied across beats.
Same raised gate arm, single track, dark road, shut stall, warm stall bulb and small signal light. Do not copy the salute, who is present, the framing, or the helmet and phone states.
Godown exterior, b8. Back of Nirala only, no lead or other face is in this exterior shot.
Interior inserts only. No people in the godown inserts. Keep the bulb, tarpaulin and stacked jute idiom, not the framing or objects from the anchor.

s09.reason: Small reframe on Nirala’s worried eyes as he looks at the hand and pin below frame. Begin close within the same chest-up angle and creep closer without losing his cap.

s17.reason: Tighter second framing of the anxious front-on close, in toward Nirala’s eyes and thin moustache. Nandini’s voice leads over his face; his phrase follows on the same close.

s23.reason: Tighter on the two motionless women at the bench. Keep the pen point suspended over the page and the knitted case between them in view.

s28.reason: Same single on Nandini writing, held on a subtly tighter push. Her attention stays on the page. The spoken figure and her own murmur meet on this face.

s31.reason: Second framing of the needles stopped dead over orange wool. Tight around the phone and needle tips, lit screen just off centre. Hold through the cloth rustle.

s32.reason: Return to the held eyes-up close on Nandini. This framing tightens around both eyes and the mouth as she states what just happened.

s33.reason: One last live close on the handset, knitted orange edges and lit blank screen above centre. Crop tighter than the earlier wool insert while preserving the relevant outline.

method_notes: Generate the four anchors first and obtain an independent anchor check before generating later shots.

A and B use the lead’s first usable single/two-shot. C and D carry no lead on camera and require respectively a reverse silhouette exterior anchor and a faceless interior truck anchor. Preserve the script’s separation of these geographies.
Every frame is issued from the committed prompt files via production/scripts/codex-frame.sh. The last attachment is the scene anchor or, for an anchor shot, the approved real_thana style frame.
s19 and s16 add the approved period 1b Nirala sheet to their height line-up sheet. Period 1b costume and shot state win if the line-up shows the earlier medal.

remap_notes.planned_durations: Measured accepted voice files by language, with the highest accepted take per line, planned shot silences, 0.25 s between lines in a shot, small cut handles, and word-count shares for two intra-line cuts. Whole-clip time, before assembled edit measurement. Split onset must be placed by the editor.
deviations_from_beat_action: Omit the optional pink-slip insert. Its evidentiary turn stays heard over the 0.8 s rustle, with no face inside the godown.
Keep the phone hidden in Nandini’s right trouser pocket from the branch seam until transfer, as continuity.json resolves. No exposed pocket prop needs a script change.
The eyes-up close at s30 is framed to carry Nandini’s answer at s32 as a tighter second framing. The motionless wool close supplies s31 and s33, with the separate dark screen made for s35.
Hold the b5 checklist on the designed push-in, as the script asks. The b9 pen-stop insert is held across the two phone lines. These holds follow the accepted take lengths.

edit_notes_for_episode_editor: Use the two cut_on_word entries from remap_notes. The l02/l03 cut is a cut at the end of l02, not a cut inside l03.
Preserve silent lead s05=1.0, s11=0.8, s21=2.0, s30=1.5, and any lead marked in the shot list. Place tails s28=0.8 for paper rustle, s31=1.0 for cloth rustle, and s35=1.5 for dead line.
s22 is the 2.5 s shutter shot and holds the bilingual place super. If the place super overlaps the next cut, keep it within the godown shot.
Filter the phone rows from the bilingual scripts through the existing phone effect per line. No Bhaiyaji picture in either language.
The toy carving is shown only flat on wood and partway in a holster, in strict profile. Nil gunfire, muzzle-forward view, or real metal weapon.
not_verified: Storyboard specifications and take durations only. No anchor quality, later frame images, assembled timing or performance has been judged here.
